December outlook

Last December was not a sale month for these cards (raw-only Terapeak, Nov 2025 → Dec 2025 → Jan 2026; full data in december-seasonality-2025.csv). Prices were flat Nov→Dec for Glaceon VMAX, Sylveon V, Glaceon V, Vaporeon V, and Flareon V (which rose in January).

LIKELY LOWER Charizard V — falling 2026 trend plus last year's one real December dip (~$48–53 → ~$37–50). Sylveon ex — trend only (post-launch slide from ~$102; no Dec 2025 exists, released Jun 2026). Pikachu — slight dip last December, thin data.

NO DEC DISCOUNT EXPECTED Glaceon VMAX, Flareon V, Sylveon V, Glaceon V, Vaporeon V, Eevee ex single & set — flat last December or no seasonal pattern; buy on target price, not the calendar.

CAN'T MEASURE CSHC set (December rests on one trio sale) and Charizard & Mewtwo set (Terapeak only sees its sealed boxes, not the loose pair).

30th Celebration — English vs Simplified Chinese

The anniversary set launched worldwide on the same day (Sep 16, 2026). The Simplified Chinese edition (30thC) is numbered /103, not /128 — numbers differ per card. Chinese copies of the big SIRs run about 1/3 of the English price, and their sold prices were still deflating on Oct 27, 2026 (latest solds below today’s asks on several cards). Tracked daily from Oct 27, 2026. Markets = PriceCharting ungraded; CN solds = PriceCharting history (headline, pre-shipping). Card photos show the English versions.

Buying all 8 today: English $327.77 · Simplified Chinese $144.64 — Chinese saves $183.13 (56%).

How to read this
  • Sold history: PriceCharting aggregates eBay solds and shows the ~30 most recent per card (headline prices, before shipping); graded slabs and mis-titled cards were filtered out by title/photo. Live eBay sold checks cover the last ~90 days. Full data: sold-history-2026.csv (154 sales) and sold-monthly-2026.csv.
  • Coverage limits: only Glaceon VMAX and Glaceon V have readable sales back to January. Charizard V / Sylveon V start in June; the Terastal Gathering cards released Jun 12, 2026 and their readable raw record is October only; the Pikachu promo has just 7 sales (Sep–Oct) plus Terapeak volume; the Eevee set's history comes from Terapeak grouped rows.
  • Charizard rule: titles lie — a NEW lowest Charizard listing is photo-verified as the 132/127 alt art before it counts (the standing verified lowest is spot-checked weekly), and your $88 TCGcard-China listing is watched for selling/ending/repricing.
  • Card images: official artwork (English/Japanese printings of the same art) via Bulbagarden Archives. The Pikachu 066/S-P VW promo has no official image available anywhere, so it shows a placeholder instead of an eBay photo.
  • Prices refresh daily (~9:20am PT) in this chat's side thread. Browsing only — nothing is bought or bid on.
